changes.text: The Company sold its merchant services business in 2024, and its results are reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As a result of the sale of the Merchant Services Business in 2024 and the Healthcare RCM Business in 2025, the results of operations for the Merchant Services Business and Healthcare RCM Business have been reflected as discontinued operations in our consolidated statements of operations for all periods presented.

changes.text: The Company sold its Healthcare RCM Business in 2025, leaving a single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: After giving effect to the sale of our Healthcare RCM Business on May 5, 2025, as described below, the Company provides mission-critical enterprise software solutions to its public sector customers.

changes.text: Segment reporting changed from two reportable segments to one reportable segment as of 2025.
changes.evidence: After giving effect to the disposition of the Healthcare RCM Business, the Company determined that it had one operating segment and one reportable segment as of June 30, 2025, and accordingly has updated its segment presentation to reflect this determination.
